en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 to remain overnight and into Wednesday morning
en.dek: Tropical Depression Saudel was about 240 km southeast of Hong Kong at 9pm; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 would remain in force tonight and through Wednesday morning as Tropical Depression Saudel continued to track across the northern South China Sea.

At 9pm, Saudel was centred about 240 kilometres southeast of Hong Kong and was forecast to move northeast at about 14 kilometres per hour, edging closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong and intensifying gradually. Outer rainbands were bringing squally showers and thunderstorms to the Guangdong coast.

Under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds were expected to be occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The Observatory said that unless Saudel intensified significantly and its associated strong winds moved closer to the Pearl River Estuary, the chance of strong winds generally over Hong Kong remained relatively low. A tropical cyclone warning signal may stay in force until later in the week.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號今晚及明早維持 沙德爾繼續靠近粵東
zh.dek: 熱帶低氣壓沙德爾晚上9時位於本港東南約240公里；天文台指今明兩日改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。
body: 天文台表示，一號戒備信號會在今晚及明早維持，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾繼續橫過南海北部。
晚上9時，沙德爾集結在香港東南約240公里，預料向東北移動，時速約14公里，逐漸靠近廣東東部沿岸並增強。其外圍雨帶為廣東沿岸帶來狂風驟雨及雷暴。
受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。天文台指，除非沙德爾顯著增強及其相關強風區更接近珠江口一帶，否則本港普遍吹強風機會不大，今明兩日改發三號強風信號機會較低。預料熱帶氣旋警告信號可能需維持至本周後期。
